title: San Francisco’s Housing Authority could not support charges to three federal grants

beats.text: Three San Francisco public housing expenditures lacked records to support the charges.

visual.sub: HUD grant auditors could not substantiate three expenditures totaling $20,935

beats.text: The 2016 audit questioned $20,935 for those three transactions.
Five expenses from a different year were also corrected.

visual.kicker: HUD grant auditors could not substantiate three expenditures totaling $20,935

beats.text: The same audit questioned how staff payroll was divided between federal grants.

visual.kicker: The Authority could not support how it divided payroll between grant programs

beats.text: The Authority assigned 10.74 percent to project-based assistance without supporting the rate.

visual.kicker: The Authority could not support how it divided payroll between grant programs

beats.text: Capital Fund time sheets also failed to support six selected payroll charges.

visual.kicker: The Authority could not support how it divided payroll between grant programs

beats.text: In the following year auditors tested 60 payroll transactions per program.

visual.kicker: The next year’s payroll tests questioned amounts in all three programs

beats.text: Five project-based and five public housing transactions lacked support.

visual.kicker: The next year’s payroll tests questioned amounts in all three programs

beats.text: Eight Capital Fund transactions lacked support, representing $28,444 in likely questioned costs.
The 2018 follow-up listed the consolidated payroll finding as corrected.

visual.kicker: The next audit listed the consolidated payroll finding as corrected

beats.text: It did not itemize repayments for those samples.
